# activedirectory_user (Data Source)

Look up a user by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Errors if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single user by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Exactly one
# identity attribute must be set; the lookup errors if the user is absent.
data "activedirectory_user" "jdoe" {
  sam_account_name = "jdoe"
}

output "jdoe_upn" {
  value = data.activedirectory_user.jdoe.user_principal_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dn` (String) Look the object up by distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) Look the object up by objectGUID.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Look the object up by sAMAccountName.
- `sid` (String) Look the object up by security identifier.

### Read-Only

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Account expiry (RFC 3339), or null if it never expires.
- `can_change_password` (Boolean) Whether the user may change their password.
- `change_password_at_logon` (Boolean) Whether the user must change password at next logon.
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `given_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `name` (String) The user's name (RDN).
- `password_expires` (Boolean) Whether the password expires.
- `surname` (String) Last name.
- `user_principal_name` (String) The UPN.
